title: From Simulation to Experiment: Benchmarking Machine-Learning Models for Quantum-Dot State Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2511.22451v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine-learning models for quantum-dot state recognition are commonly trained using synthetic data, where large labeled datasets can be generated efficiently. However, strong performance on simulated data does not guarantee equally strong performance in experiments. Here, we benchmark five neural network architectures for quantum-dot state recognition using a shared synthetic training dataset and independent synthetic and experimental test sets. We compare convolutional and fully connected neural networks, a mixture density network, a vision transformer, and a U-Net across multiple training set sizes and two input normalization schemes. We find that model performance and rankings are closely preserved when moving from held-out synthetic patches to previously unseen simulated devices, but change substantially when the same models are evaluated on experimental data. translated_title: 从模拟到实验：量子点态识别机器学习模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: 量子点态识别的机器学习模型通常使用合成数据进行训练，因为这样可以高效地生成大规模带标签的数据集。然而，模型在模拟数据上的优异表现并不能保证其在实验中同样表现出色。在本研究中，我们使用共享的合成训练数据集以及相互独立的合成测试集和实验测试集，对五种用于量子点态识别的神经网络架构进行了基准测试。我们在多种训练集规模和两种输入归一化方案下，比较了卷积神经网络、全连接神经网络、混合密度网络、视觉Transformer以及U-Net。我们发现，当从保留的合成数据块迁移到此前未见的模拟器件时，模型的性能和排名基本得以保持；但当相同的模型在实验数据上进行评估时，其性能和排名发生了显著变化。特别是，在合成数据上取得最高性能的架构……
tldr: 该论文对五种神经网络架构在共享合成训练数据及独立的合成与实验测试集上进行了系统基准测试，发现模型在模拟数据上的性能排名无法可靠地推广到实验数据，揭示了量子点态识别中模拟到实验迁移的关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks five neural network architectures for quantum-dot state recognition using a shared synthetic training set and independent synthetic and experimental test sets, revealing that model performance rankings on simulated data change substantially when evaluated on experimental data, highlighting the sim-to-real transfer challenge.
